![SentinelAI — Network Monitoring Platform](docs/assets/sentinelai-hero.png)

# SentinelAI **Plataforma NMS full-stack** — discovery inteligente, topologia 2D/3D, hub **Zion**, monitoramento WMI/SNMP, alertas multicanal e inventário persistente. [![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-009688?style=for-the-badge&logo=fastapi&logoColor=white)](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/) [![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-20232A?style=for-the-badge&logo=react&logoColor=61DAFB)](https://react.dev/) [![Celery](https://img.shields.io/badge/Celery-37814A?style=for-the-badge&logo=celery&logoColor=white)](https://docs.celeryq.dev/) [![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-316192?style=for-the-badge&logo=postgresql&logoColor=white)](https://www.postgresql.org/) [![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-2496ED?style=for-the-badge&logo=docker&logoColor=white)](https://www.docker.com/) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Proprietary-red?style=for-the-badge)](#licença) [![GitHub Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/CanonEngineer/SentinelAI?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=white&color=38bdf8)](https://github.com/CanonEngineer/SentinelAI/stargazers) [![CI main](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/CanonEngineer/SentinelAI/ci.yml?branch=main&style=for-the-badge&label=CI&logo=githubactions&logoColor=white&color=0ea5e9)](https://github.com/CanonEngineer/SentinelAI/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Último commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/CanonEngineer/SentinelAI/main?style=for-the-badge&logo=git&logoColor=white&color=0284c7)](https://github.com/CanonEngineer/SentinelAI/commits/main/)


[![SentinelAI — mapa 3D isométrico da estrutura do repositório](docs/assets/sentinelai-structure-3d.png)](https://github.com/CanonEngineer/SentinelAI/raw/main/docs/assets/sentinelai-structure-3d.svg)

*Pré-visualização estática acima (PNG). Repositório **privado**: para **Animação 3D** / **Viewer**, faça **login no GitHub** com acesso ao repo (URLs `github.com/.../raw/...`, não `raw.githubusercontent.com`).*
--- ## O que é **SentinelAI** é uma plataforma de **monitoramento e inventário de infraestrutura de rede** pensada para equipes de engenharia e NOC. Combina: - Scan de sub-rede com **Nmap configurável** (perfis quick → aggressive) - Inventário **ativo + inativo** em sub-rede completa (`/24`) - **Mapa de topologia** interativo (React Flow) com vista **3D** - Hub operacional **Zion** — painéis por IP/métrica (CPU, RAM, disco, temperatura…) - Coleta **WMI** (Windows) + **SNMP**, alertas multicanal e relatórios - Paginação no dashboard (eventos 10/100 · dispositivos 10/2500) - Roadmap de **estabilização** (Fase 0+) além das fases enterprise 15–21 - **ZionVM** — gestão de VMs/LXC, storage, rede, backup, consola VNC/SPICE e agente nos nós (lab KVM — botões abaixo) - **ZionXDR** — inventário de endpoints, políticas, telemetria, alertas, playbooks de resposta e ponte **Eagle** (visão geral — botões abaixo) - **MFA TOTP** na gestão de utilizadores (Google Authenticator / Authy)

--- ## Ecossistema (NMS + produtos) ```mermaid flowchart TB subgraph Core["SentinelAI Core"] NMS[Discovery + Inventário] MAP[Mapa 2D / 3D] ALT[Alertas multicanal] ZION[Hub Zion] end subgraph Products["Produtos integrados"] ZVM[ZionVM — hypervisor / datacenter] XDR[ZionXDR — endpoints & resposta] end subgraph Ops["Operação"] AG[Agentes nó / endpoint] BK[Backup v2.8] INS[Instalador on-prem] end NMS --> ZION MAP --> ZION ZION --> ZVM ZION --> XDR ZVM --> AG XDR --> AG NMS --> BK NMS --> INS ``` | Produto | Documentação | UI | |---------|--------------|-----| | **ZionVM** | | | | **ZionXDR** | | | | **Tree of Knowledge** | Mapa **2D** e **Galaxy 3D** do código | |

# =============================================================================
# SentinelAI — LAB / DEV ONLY template
# Copie para `.env` e troque TODAS as credenciais antes de qualquer deploy.
# Em APP_ENV=production, SECRET_KEY e ADMIN_PASSWORD fracos bloqueiam o arranque.
# Valores abaixo são placeholders deliberadamente fracos — NÃO usar em produção.
# =============================================================================

# Database (LAB) — senha alinhada ao default do docker-compose.yml
POSTGRES_USER=sentinel
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=sentinel_secret
POSTGRES_DB=sentinelai
DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://sentinel:sentinel_secret@postgres:5432/sentinelai
DATABASE_URL_SYNC=postgresql://sentinel:sentinel_secret@postgres:5432/sentinelai

# Redis
REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379/0

# API
# Gere com: openssl rand -hex 32
SECRET_KEY=change-me-in-production-use-openssl-rand-hex-32
# development | production — em production, SECRET_KEY e ADMIN_PASSWORD fracos bloqueiam o arranque
APP_ENV=development
API_HOST=0.0.0.0
API_PORT=8000
CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:3000
# LAN: ao abrir http://<IP>:5173 no outro PC, o proxy Vite evita CORS extra.
# Se precisar API direta na porta 8000, acrescente: http://192.168.x.86:5173

# Auth (admin criado no 1º arranque; senha fraca força troca só no 1º login)
# LAB ONLY — troque imediatamente após bootstrap
ADMIN_USERNAME=admin
ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin123
# false = não sobrescrever a senha da BD com a do .env a cada restart
# true  = forçar sync (útil só no bootstrap / reset intencional)
ADMIN_SYNC_PASSWORD=false
# Pedir nova senha a cada N dias (0 = desativa rotação mensal)
PASSWORD_MAX_AGE_DAYS=30

# HTTP rate limits (P1.6) — sliding window por IP (req/minuto)
RATE_LIMIT_LOGIN_PER_MINUTE=20
RATE_LIMIT_AUTH_SENSITIVE_PER_MINUTE=10
RATE_LIMIT_AI_PER_MINUTE=30
RATE_LIMIT_WRITE_PER_MINUTE=60
RATE_LIMIT_REMEDIATION_PER_MINUTE=20

# Email alerts (optional)
SMTP_HOST=
SMTP_PORT=587
SMTP_USER=
SMTP_PASSWORD=
SMTP_FROM=noreply@sentinelai.local
ALERT_EMAIL_TO=

# Alert channels (comma-separated: email,sms,push,telegram,discord,slack,teams,webhook)
ALERT_CHANNELS_ENABLED=email,webhook
TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=
TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID=
DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL=
SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL=
TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL=
GENERIC_WEBHOOK_URL=
TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID=
TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN=
TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER=
ALERT_SMS_TO=
EXPO_PUSH_ACCESS_TOKEN=
# Web Push (Fase 24) — gere com: python -c "from py_vapid import Vapid01; v=Vapid01(); v.generate_keys(); print(v.public_key); print(v.private_pem().decode())"
VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY=
VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY=
VAPID_SUBJECT=mailto:admin@sentinelai.local
ALERT_ESCALATION_MINUTES=15
ALERT_SUPPRESS_REPEAT_MINUTES=30

# LDAP / Active Directory (optional)
LDAP_ENABLED=false
LDAP_SERVER=ldap://dc.example.com
LDAP_PORT=389
LDAP_USE_SSL=false
LDAP_BASE_DN=DC=example,DC=com
LDAP_BIND_DN=
LDAP_BIND_PASSWORD=
LDAP_USER_SEARCH_FILTER=(sAMAccountName={username})
LDAP_DEFAULT_ROLE=viewer

# Org SSO OIDC (Sprint D1) — Authorization Code + PKCE
# Redirect URI no IdP deve bater com OIDC_REDIRECT_URI.
OIDC_ENABLED=false
OIDC_ISSUER=https://login.microsoftonline.com/<tenant>/v2.0
OIDC_CLIENT_ID=
OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET=
OIDC_REDIRECT_URI=http://localhost:8800/api/auth/oidc/callback
OIDC_SCOPES=openid profile email
OIDC_DEFAULT_ROLE=viewer
OIDC_DEFAULT_ORG_SLUG=default
# Opcional: claim de roles/groups e claim de org slug
OIDC_ROLE_CLAIM=
OIDC_ORG_CLAIM=
OIDC_FRONTEND_SUCCESS_URL=http://localhost:5173
# true = IdP MFA basta (não pede TOTP local após SSO)
OIDC_SKIP_LOCAL_MFA=true

# Reports
REPORTS_OUTPUT_DIR=/app/reports

# Platform Backup (Fase 28) — menu Backup
# BACKUP_REPO_PATH=/app/backups/primary

# Changelog — SentinelAI

## [2.2.7] — 2026-07-29

### Operação P1.3
- **Retenção de métricas:** `METRICS_RETENTION_DAYS` (default 90); Celery cleanup lê settings
- **Zion cobertura:** retention days, sample count, oldest metric, tabela sem WMI
- **Histórico profundo:** DeviceMetricsTab com janelas 24h/7d/30d; aba Histórico Zion com seletor de device + gráfico

## [2.2.6] — 2026-07-29

### Segurança P1.6
- Rate limits por IP além do login: auth sensível, AI chat (copilot/chatbot), writes (devices/topology), remediation
- Knobs `RATE_LIMIT_*` em config + `.env.example` (LAB-ONLY)
- Docs: `SPRINT-TRUST-P0` P1.6 ✅, `SECURITY-REVIEW-v2.2` atualizado

## [2.2.5] — 2026-07-29

### Operação P1.5 / UX mapa
- Tráfego no mapa: SNMP quando a porta casa; sem match → **Mbps simulado** + linha contínua/partícula (efeito clássico restaurado a pedido)
- Cards: pulse/glow por status (online/offline/aguardando)

## [2.2.4] — 2026-07-29

### Operação P1.2
- **Alertas:** silence/snooze por fingerprint (`alert_silences`), dedupe via `ALERT_SUPPRESS_REPEAT_MINUTES`, enrichment hostname/IP/site no payload
- UI: snooze na tabela + lista de silences

## [2.2.3] — 2026-07-29

### Operação P1.4
- **Inventário único:** `docs/feature-inventory.json` canónico; espelho sync em `backend/app/data/`; `sync` / `check-sync` no CLI; mount `./docs:/docs:ro` no Compose; CI valida alinhamento

## [2.2.2] — 2026-07-29

### Operação P1.1
- **Playbooks YAML:** motor de remediação carrega builtins de `engines/remediation/playbooks/*.yaml` e `CustomPlaybook` do DB; ações `log|ping|snmp|http|ssh|reopen_inactive|ack_stale_alerts|topology_gap`
- Dep: `PyYAML`

## [2.2.1] — 2026-07-29

### Trust P0
- **Zion SLA:** `sla_avg_pct` passa a ser média de uptime ping 7d (não mais cópia de `availability_pct`); UI distingue “Online agora” vs “SLA 7d”
- **Config restore:** aprovação HITL enfileira `run_config_restore` (SSH apply Cisco-like) com eventos applied/failed
- **Release:** plano `docs/SPRINT-TRUST-P0.md`; tag `v2.2.0` na base 2.2

## [2.2.0] — 2026-07-28

### Fase 8 — MSP / fechamento
- **SLA por site:** `GET /api/sites/{id}/sla`, contrato thin (`PUT .../sla-contract`), PDF mensal `report_type=sla`
- **Playbooks visuais:** canvas de steps no Platform (Autonomous) ligado ao motor + HITL
- **Hardening:** rate limit em `/api/auth/login`; backup agendável (`scripts/schedule-backup.ps1`)
- Docs: `docs/UPGRADE-v2.2.md`, `docs/SECURITY-REVIEW-v2.2.md`

### Fase 7 — Agent + CMDB
- Agent lab (`POST /api/agents/metrics`, `agent/sentinel_lab_agent.py`)
- Change feed CMDB + config unified diff + aprovação `config_restore`

### Fase 6 — Sensores + NOC Wall
- OID custom CRUD/histórico/limiares
- NOC Wall TV + URL tokenizada

### Fases 1–5 (resumo)
- SSE Redis, discovery SNMP, Zion, credenciais Fernet, Alembic/pytest/CI, LLM seguro

Consulte `docs/CRONOGRAMA-ESTABILIZACAO.md` e `docs/feature-inventory.json` para o inventário completo.

# SentinelAI — deploy HA (Fase 11)
# Uso: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.ha.yml up --build
#
# Adiciona réplica da API, Redis Sentinel (modo dev) e variáveis HA.
# Para produção, configure PostgreSQL streaming replica externamente.

services:
  redis-sentinel:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    command: >
      sh -c "echo 'sentinel monitor mymaster redis 6379 1' > /tmp/sentinel.conf &&
             echo 'sentinel down-after-milliseconds mymaster 5000' >> /tmp/sentinel.conf &&
             redis-sentinel /tmp/sentinel.conf"
    ports:
      - "26379:26379"
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy

  api-replica:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    command: uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --timeout-graceful-shutdown 8
    env_file:
      - .env
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://sentinel:sentinel_secret@postgres:5432/sentinelai
      DATABASE_URL_SYNC: postgresql://sentinel:sentinel_secret@postgres:5432/sentinelai
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
      HA_MODE: "true"
      API_NODE_ID: api-replica-1
      API_NODE_ROLE: replica
    volumes:
      - ./backend:/app
      - reports_data:/app/reports
    ports:
      - "8001:8000"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    cap_add:
      - NET_RAW

  api:
    environment:
      HA_MODE: "true"
      API_NODE_ID: api-primary
      API_NODE_ROLE: primary
      REDIS_SENTINEL_HOSTS: redis-sentinel:26379

  nginx-lb:
    image: nginx:alpine
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - ./deploy/nginx-ha.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:ro
    depends_on:
      - api
      - api-replica

# PostgreSQL streaming replica (dev)
# Uso: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.replica.yml up
#
# Primary: postgres :5432 | Replica read-only: postgres-replica :5433

services:
  postgres:
    command: >
      postgres
      -c wal_level=replica
      -c max_wal_senders=3
      -c max_replication_slots=3
      -c hot_standby=on
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./deploy/postgres/primary/init-replication.sh:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01-replication.sh:ro

      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-sentinel_secret}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-sentinelai}
      PGUSER: replicator

    ports:

    depends_on:

services:

    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-sentinel}

      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-sentinelai}
    volumes:

    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-sentinel} -d ${POSTGRES_DB:-sentinelai}"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5

  api:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    # Produção/estável por omissão (sem --reload). Dev: -f docker-compose.dev.yml
    command: uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --timeout-graceful-shutdown 8
    env_file:
      - path: .env
        required: false
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://${POSTGRES_USER:-sentinel}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-sentinel_secret}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-sentinelai}
      DATABASE_URL_SYNC: postgresql://${POSTGRES_USER:-sentinel}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-sentinel_secret}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-sentinelai}
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
      ZIONVM_HYPERVISOR_DRIVER: ${ZIONVM_HYPERVISOR_DRIVER:-stub}
      ZIONXDR_EAGLE_ROOT: ${ZIONXDR_EAGLE_ROOT:-/eagle-agent}
    volumes:
      - ./backend:/app
      - ./docs:/docs:ro
      - ./agent:/agent:ro
      - ./zionxdr/eagle-offensive-platform/agent:/eagle-agent:ro
      - reports_data:/app/reports
      - backups_data:/app/backups
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
      - "2055:2055/udp"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "python -c \"import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8000/health')\""]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s
    cap_add:
      - NET_RAW

  worker:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    command: celery -A app.workers.celery_app worker --loglevel=info --concurrency=4 -Q celery,zionvm
    env_file:
      - path: .env
        required: false
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://${POSTGRES_USER:-sentinel}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-sentinel_secret}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-sentinelai}
      DATABASE_URL_SYNC: postgresql://${POSTGRES_USER:-sentinel}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-sentinel_secret}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-sentinelai}
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
      ZIONVM_HYPERVISOR_DRIVER: ${ZIONVM_HYPERVISOR_DRIVER:-stub}
      ZIONXDR_EAGLE_ROOT: ${ZIONXDR_EAGLE_ROOT:-/eagle-agent}
    volumes:
      - ./backend:/app
      - ./docs:/docs:ro
      - ./zionxdr/eagle-offensive-platform/agent:/eagle-agent:ro
      - reports_data:/app/reports
      - backups_data:/app/backups
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    cap_add:
      - NET_RAW

  discovery-worker:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    command: celery -A app.workers.celery_app worker --loglevel=info --concurrency=2 -Q discovery
    env_file:
      - path: .env
        required: false
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://${POSTGRES_USER:-sentinel}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-sentinel_secret}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-sentinelai}
      DATABASE_URL_SYNC: postgresql://${POSTGRES_USER:-sentinel}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-sentinel_secret}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-sentinelai}
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
    volumes:
      - ./backend:/app
      - ./docs:/docs:ro
      - reports_data:/app/reports
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    cap_add:
      - NET_RAW

  beat:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    command: celery -A app.workers.celery_app beat --loglevel=info
    env_file:
      - path: .env

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
      - name: Feature inventory sync check
        working-directory: .
        run: python scripts/feature-inventory.py check-sync
      - name: Ruff lint
        run: ruff check app tests --select E9,F63,F7,F82
      - name: Compile Python modules
        run: python -m compileall app
      - name: Alembic upgrade
        run: alembic upgrade head

  frontend:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import pickle
import re
from pathlib import Path

data = pickle.load(open(r"c:\Users\aosebastiao\Desktop\SentinelAI\_recover_out\peak_data.pkl", "rb"))


def ck(src: str):
    m = re.search(r":L(\d+)$", src)
    line = int(m.group(1)) if m else 0
    if "57ed" in src:
        t = 0
    elif "a8f9" in src:
        t = 1
    elif "subagents" not in src:
        t = 2
    else:
        t = 3
    return (t, line)


def analyze(path: str):
    writes = data["writes"].get(path, [])
    srs = data["strreplaces"].get(path, [])
    print(f"\n## {path}")
    print(
        "writes:",
        [(w["src"].split("/")[-1], w["len"]) for w in sorted(writes, key=lambda w: ck(w["src"]))],
    )
    if not writes:
        return
    last_w = max(writes, key=lambda w: (ck(w["src"]), w["len"]))
    lt, ll = ck(last_w["src"])
    after = [s for s in srs if ck(s["src"]) > (lt, ll)]
    before = [s for s in srs if ck(s["src"]) <= (lt, ll)]
    print(f"last_write {last_w['src']} len={last_w['len']}")
    print(
        f"SR before/at last write: {len(before)}, after: {len(after)}, "
        f"after_delta_sum={sum(s['delta'] for s in after)}"
    )
    text = last_w["contents"]
    ok = fail = 0
    for s in sorted(after, key=lambda s: ck(s["src"])):
        if s["old"] not in text:
            fail += 1
            continue
        if s.get("replace_all"):
            text = text.replace(s["old"], s["new"])
        else:
            text = text.replace(s["old"], s["new"], 1)
        ok += 1
    print(
        f"post-last-write replay: {len(last_w['contents'])} -> {len(text)} ok={ok} fail={fail}"
    )

    # Also: max size during full replay after each event
    events = [("w", w) for w in writes] + [("s", s) for s in srs]
    events = sorted(events, key=lambda e: ck(e[1]["src"]))
    text = ""
    max_len = 0
    for kind, p in events:
        if kind == "w":
            text = p["contents"]
        else:
            if p["old"] and p["old"] in text:
                if p.get("replace_all"):
                    text = text.replace(p["old"], p["new"])
                else:
                    text = text.replace(p["old"], p["new"], 1)
        max_len = max(max_len, len(text))
    print(f"full_replay_final={len(text)} max_during={max_len}")


for p in [
    "frontend/src/pages/ZionvmManagerPanel.tsx",
    "frontend/src/pages/ZionvmOpsPanel.tsx",
    "frontend/src/pages/ZionvmPermissionsPanel.tsx",
    "frontend/src/pages/ZionvmCorpParityPanel.tsx",
    "frontend/src/styles/zionvm-corp-fx.css",
    "frontend/src/styles/zionvm-ds.css",
    "frontend/src/components/zionvm/ZionvmClusterPanel.tsx",
    "backend/app/services/zionvm_parity.py",
    "backend/app/services/zionvm_agent_jobs.py",
]:
    analyze(p)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Diff HEAD vs current ZionVMPage for lost corp polish."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(r"c:\Users\aosebastiao\Desktop\SentinelAI")
head = (ROOT / "_recover_out" / "HEAD_ZionVMPage.tsx").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
cur = (ROOT / "frontend" / "src" / "pages" / "ZionVMPage.tsx").read_text(encoding="utf-8")

panel_paths = list((ROOT / "frontend" / "src" / "components" / "zionvm").glob("*.tsx"))
panel_paths += list((ROOT / "frontend" / "src" / "pages").glob("Zionvm*.tsx"))
panel_text = "\n".join(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8") for p in panel_paths)
combined = cur + "\n" + panel_text

# All class tokens
tok_re = re.compile(r"(?:sa-corp|zvm-ds|zvm-)[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+")

def tokens(t: str) -> set[str]:
    return set(tok_re.findall(t))

head_tok = tokens(head)
cur_tok = tokens(cur)
panel_tok = tokens(panel_text)
missing_from_page = sorted(head_tok - cur_tok)
missing_everywhere = sorted(head_tok - tokens(combined))

print("=== Tokens in HEAD not in current page ===")
for t in missing_from_page:
    loc = "IN_PANEL" if t in panel_tok else "LOST"
    print(f"  {loc:8} {t}")

print("\n=== Tokens LOST everywhere (not page, not panels) ===")
for t in missing_everywhere:
    print(f"  {t}")

# Line-level: HEAD lines with polish that aren't (approx) in combined
print("\n=== LOST polish lines (unique, trimmed) ===")
lost_lines = []
seen = set()
for i, line in enumerate(head.splitlines(), 1):
    if not re.search(r"sa-corp|zvm-ds-", line):
        continue
    s = line.strip()
    if not s or s in seen:
        continue
    seen.add(s)
    # normalize whitespace for presence check
    if s in combined or s[:60] in combined:
        continue
    # also check if key class substring exists sufficiently
    classes = tok_re.findall(s)
    if classes and all(c in combined for c in classes):
        # classes exist but this exact markup may differ — still note if structural
        pass
    lost_lines.append((i, s))

for i, s in lost_lines[:80]:
    print(f"L{i}: {s[:160]}")

print(f"\nTotal unique LOST polish lines: {len(lost_lines)}")

# Structural sections: find view branches
print("\n=== View kind branches HEAD vs CUR ===")
for kind in [
    "dashboard", "cluster", "node", "vm", "storage", "network", "ha",
    "manager", "operations", "permissions", "tasks", "console", "backup", "lxc",
    "create",
]:
    h = len(re.findall(rf'view\.kind === ["\']{kind}["\']|kind === ["\']{kind}["\']', head))
    c = len(re.findall(rf'view\.kind === ["\']{kind}["\']|kind === ["\']{kind}["\']', cur))
    print(f"  {kind:14} HEAD={h} CUR={c}")

# KPI / empty / join-submit blocks
print("\n=== Feature snippets in HEAD ===")
for label, pat in [
    ("join-submit", r"zvm-ds-join-submit"),
    ("kpi-ok", r"zvm-ds-kpi-ok"),
    ("kpi strip", r"zvm-ds-kpi"),
    ("sa-corp-shell", r"sa-corp"),
    ("empty", r"empty|sem |nenhum|Nenhum|vazio"),
    ("form-field-md", r"zvm-ds-form-field-md"),
    ("inline-form", r"zvm-ds-inline-form"),
]:
    hm = list(re.finditer(pat, head, re.I))
    cm = list(re.finditer(pat, cur, re.I))
    pm = list(re.finditer(pat, panel_text, re.I))
    print(f"  {label:14} HEAD={len(hm)} CUR={len(cm)} PANEL={len(pm)}")

# Dump context around join-submit and kpi-ok from HEAD
out = ROOT / "_recover_out" / "HEAD_polish_snippets.txt"
chunks = []
for pat in [r"zvm-ds-join-submit", r"zvm-ds-kpi-ok", r"sa-corp-[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+", r"zvm-ds-empty"]:
    for m in re.finditer(pat, head):
        start = max(0, m.start() - 400)
        end = min(len(head), m.end() + 400)
        chunks.append(f"\n===== {pat} @ {m.start()} =====\n{head[start:end]}\n")

out.write_text("\n".join(chunks[:40]), encoding="utf-8")
print(f"\nWrote {out}")

"""ZionVM S19–S25 — parity API and driver."""

import uuid

from app.services.zionvm_parity import effective_hypervisor_driver, build_parity_dashboard


def test_effective_hypervisor_driver_auto_dev(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr("app.config.settings.zionvm_hypervisor_driver", "auto")
    monkeypatch.setattr("app.config.settings.app_env", "development")
    assert effective_hypervisor_driver() == "stub"


def test_effective_hypervisor_driver_auto_prod(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr("app.config.settings.zionvm_hypervisor_driver", "auto")
    monkeypatch.setattr("app.config.settings.app_env", "production")
    assert effective_hypervisor_driver() == "agent"


def test_parity_dashboard(client, auth_headers, db_session):
    from app.db_sync import SyncSession

    with SyncSession() as session:
        body = build_parity_dashboard(session)
    assert body["release"]
    assert len(body["sprints"]) == 7
    assert body["sprints"][0]["id"] == "19"

    r = client.get("/api/zionvm/v1/parity/dashboard", headers=auth_headers)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.json()
    assert data["hypervisor_driver_effective"] in {"stub", "agent"}


def test_node_maintenance_task(client, auth_headers, zionvm_topology):
    node_id = zionvm_topology["nodes"][0]["id"]
    r = client.post(
        f"/api/zionvm/v1/nodes/{node_id}/maintenance",
        headers=auth_headers,
        json={"enabled": True, "reason": "patch window"},
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201
    assert r.json()["task_type"] == "node.maintenance"


def test_network_bond_task(client, auth_headers, zionvm_topology):
    node_id = zionvm_topology["nodes"][0]["id"]
    r = client.post(
        f"/api/zionvm/v1/nodes/{node_id}/network/bond",
        headers=auth_headers,
        json={"name": "bond0", "slaves": ["eth0"]},
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201
    assert r.json()["task_type"] == "network.bond_create"


def test_corosync_probe_task(client, auth_headers, zionvm_topology):
    cluster_id = zionvm_topology["cluster"]["id"]
    r = client.post(
        "/api/zionvm/v1/clusters/corosync-probe",
        headers=auth_headers,
        json={"cluster_id": cluster_id},
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201
    assert r.json()["task_type"] == "cluster.corosync_probe"


def test_iscsi_still_creates_task(client, auth_headers, zionvm_topology):
    node_id = zionvm_topology["nodes"][0]["id"]
    name = f"iscsi-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}"
    r = client.post(
        f"/api/zionvm/v1/nodes/{node_id}/storage/iscsi",
        headers=auth_headers,
        json={"name": name, "portal": "192.0.2.1:3260", "target_iqn": "iqn.2026.test:disk1"},
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201

nodes.code:
# ZionVM corp polish restore — 2026-09-24

## Evidence dumps
- `_recover_out/HEAD_ZionVMPage.tsx` — `git show HEAD:frontend/src/pages/ZionVMPage.tsx` (104047 bytes UTF-8)
- `_recover_out/e549_L5083_ZvmNumberField.tsx` — peak Write from e549 transcript L5083 (2534 content bytes)
- Diff helpers: `diff_polish.py`, `diff_polish2.py`, `diff_polish3.py`, `diff_classname.py`, `extract_number_field.py`

## Size context
| Artifact | Bytes |
|----------|------:|
| HEAD ZionVMPage | 104047 |
| Current ZionVMPage (panel-extracted) | ~84KB |
| Delta explained | Storage/Network/HA moved to panels (panels already richer than HEAD inline) |

## Diff findings (HEAD vs current page)
- Most `sa-corp` / `zvm-ds-*` chrome for Storage/Network/HA already lives in extracted panels.
- Literally missing from panels (was on HEAD submit buttons): `zvm-ds-join-submit`
- `zvm-ds-kpi-ok`: HEAD used literal class; HA panel already emits it via `accent="ok"` → `zvm-ds-kpi-${accent}`
- Empty-state strings present in panels (encoding-false-positives in PowerShell Out-File dump)
- Backup view (`ZionvmBackupTab`) kept on current page

## Restored (additive only)
1. **ZvmNumberField** — restored e549 peak (allowEmpty, `number | ""`, stepper bump from min) — 2534 bytes
2. **Export** — `ZvmNumberField` from `components/zionvm/index.ts` (fixes CorpParityPanel barrel import)
3. **join-submit** — Storage (5), Network (6), HA (2) form primary submits
4. **Node KPI scan fx** — `sa-corp-card-fx-scan` on node view KPI cards (matches panel HaKpi/ClusterKpi chrome)
5. **CreateVmCard** — VMID/VLAN use `allowEmpty` instead of `0` stub values

## Panel imports preserved
- ZionvmStoragePanel, ZionvmNetworkPanel, ZionvmHaPanel, ZionvmClusterPanel
- Also: Manager / Ops / Permissions / CreateVm / Backup / LXC

## Not inlined back into ZionVMPage
Re-inlining HEAD Storage/Network/HA would duplicate panels and risk feature removal. Polish was restored onto panels + shared chrome instead.

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Instala o SentinelAI Lab Agent no Windows (pacote lab — equivalente prático a MSI).

.DESCRIPTION
  Copia o agent para ProgramData, grava agent.json, opcionalmente instala psutil,
  e registra Tarefa Agendada "SentinelAI-LabAgent" (logon / a cada 1 min se cair).

.EXAMPLE
  .\install-windows.ps1 -Token "agt_xxx" -Url "http://localhost:8800"

.EXAMPLE
  # Baixar installer da API e instalar:
  irm http://localhost:8800/api/agents/install.ps1 | iex
  # (depois chame Install-SentinelLabAgent -Token ... se o script for função)
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
  [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
  [string]$Token,

  [string]$Url = "http://localhost:8800",

  [int]$Interval = 30,

  [string]$InstallDir = "$env:ProgramData\SentinelAI\Agent",

  [string]$TaskName = "SentinelAI-LabAgent",

  [switch]$SkipPsutil,

  [switch]$StartNow
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$Url = $Url.TrimEnd("/")

Write-Host "=== SentinelAI Lab Agent installer ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "URL: $Url"
Write-Host "InstallDir: $InstallDir"

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $InstallDir | Out-Null

$agentPy = Join-Path $InstallDir "sentinel_lab_agent.py"
$agentJson = Join-Path $InstallDir "agent.json"
$wrapper = Join-Path $InstallDir "run-agent.cmd"

Write-Host "Baixando agent da API..."
try {
  Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$Url/api/agents/package/sentinel_lab_agent.py" -OutFile $agentPy -UseBasicParsing
} catch {
  $local = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "sentinel_lab_agent.py"
  if (Test-Path $local) {
    Write-Host "API indisponível — usando cópia local: $local" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Copy-Item $local $agentPy -Force
  } else {
    throw "Não foi possível obter sentinel_lab_agent.py ($_)"
  }
}

@{
  url      = $Url
  token    = $Token
  interval = $Interval
} | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -Path $agentJson -Encoding UTF8

@"
@echo off
cd /d "$InstallDir"
where python >nul 2>&1
if errorlevel 1 (
  where py >nul 2>&1
  if errorlevel 1 (
    echo Python nao encontrado no PATH. Instale Python 3.11+ e reabra o terminal.
    exit /b 1
  )
  py -3 sentinel_lab_agent.py
  exit /b %ERRORLEVEL%
)
python sentinel_lab_agent.py
"@ | Set-Content -Path $wrapper -Encoding ASCII

if (-not $SkipPsutil) {
  Write-Host "Instalando psutil (métricas reais)..."
  try {
    & python -m pip install --quiet psutil 2>$null
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { & py -3 -m pip install --quiet psutil 2>$null }
  } catch {
    Write-Host "psutil opcional — agent usa fallback de lab sem ele." -ForegroundColor Yellow
  }
}

$pythonCmd = $null
if (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $pythonCmd = (Get-Command python).Source }
elseif (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $pythonCmd = "`"$((Get-Command py).Source)`" -3" }
else { throw "Python não encontrado no PATH." }

$action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute "cmd.exe" -Argument "/c `"$wrapper`""
$triggerLogon = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtLogOn
$settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -AllowStartIfOnBatteries -DontStopIfGoingOnBatteries -RestartCount 3 -RestartInterval (New-TimeSpan -Minutes 1) -ExecutionTimeLimit (New-TimeSpan -Days 3650)
$principal = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId $env:USERNAME -LogonType Interactive -RunLevel Limited

Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName -Action $action -Trigger $triggerLogon -Settings $settings -Principal $principal -Force | Out-Null

Write-Host "Tarefa agendada registrada: $TaskName" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "Config: $agentJson"

if ($StartNow) {
  Write-Host "Iniciando agent agora..."
  Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName
}

Write-Host @"

Pronto.
  - Pasta: $InstallDir
  - Task:  $TaskName
  - Ver status: Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName
  - Logs: rode manualmente: & '$wrapper'
  - Remover: .\uninstall-windows.ps1

"@ -ForegroundColor Cyan

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ZionVM node agent — install helper (systemd unit) + libvirt helper (Fase 0 lab)
# Usage: sudo ./install-zionvm-agent.sh http://control-plane:8000 <token> [VNC_HOST_IP]

set -euo pipefail
URL="${1:-}"
TOKEN="${2:-}"
VNC_HOST="${3:-$(hostname -I 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')}"
LOCAL_ROOT="${ZIONVM_LOCAL_ROOT:-/var/lib/zionvm/images}"

if [[ -z "$URL" || -z "$TOKEN" ]]; then
  echo "Usage: $0 <ZIONVM_URL> <AGENT_TOKEN> [ZIONVM_VNC_HOST]" >&2
  exit 2
fi

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
DEST=/opt/zionvm-agent
mkdir -p "$DEST" "$LOCAL_ROOT"
cp "$SCRIPT_DIR/zionvm_node_agent.py" "$DEST/"
if [[ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/zionvm_libvirt.py" ]]; then
  cp "$SCRIPT_DIR/zionvm_libvirt.py" "$DEST/"
fi

cat > "$DEST/zionvm-agent.json" <<EOF
{"url": "${URL}", "token": "${TOKEN}", "interval": 30}
EOF

cat > /etc/systemd/system/zionvm-agent.service <<EOF
[Unit]
Description=ZionVM Node Agent
After=network-online.target libvirtd.service
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=${DEST}
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 ${DEST}/zionvm_node_agent.py
Restart=always
RestartSec=10
Environment=ZIONVM_URL=${URL}
Environment=ZIONVM_AGENT_TOKEN=${TOKEN}
Environment=ZIONVM_INTERVAL=30
Environment=ZIONVM_LOCAL_ROOT=${LOCAL_ROOT}
Environment=ZIONVM_VNC_HOST=${VNC_HOST}
Environment=PYTHONPATH=${DEST}

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now zionvm-agent.service
echo "zionvm-agent installed (VNC_HOST=${VNC_HOST}, LOCAL_ROOT=${LOCAL_ROOT})"
echo "Check: systemctl status zionvm-agent"

"""Libvirt/QEMU helpers for ZionVM node agent (Sprint 14–16)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path


class LibvirtError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def _run(cmd: list[str], *, input_xml: str | None = None) -> str:
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(
            cmd,
            input=input_xml,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=120,
            check=False,
        )
    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
        raise LibvirtError(f"Comando não encontrado: {cmd[0]}") from exc
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        err = (proc.stderr or proc.stdout or "").strip()
        raise LibvirtError(err or f"exit {proc.returncode}: {' '.join(cmd)}")
    return (proc.stdout or "").strip()


def libvirt_available() -> bool:
    return shutil.which("virsh") is not None and shutil.which("qemu-img") is not None


def bridge_exists(bridge: str) -> bool:
    if not bridge:
        return False
    try:
        _run(["ip", "link", "show", bridge])
        return True
    except LibvirtError:
        return False


def domain_name(vmid: int) -> str:
    return f"zvm-{vmid}"


def vm_dir(root: Path, vmid: int) -> Path:
    d = root / f"vm-{vmid}"
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return d


def resolve_iso_path(images_root: Path, iso: str) -> Path:
    candidate = Path(iso)
    if candidate.is_file():
        return candidate
    for rel in (iso, f"iso/{iso}", Path(iso).name, f"iso/{Path(iso).name}"):
        p = images_root / rel
        if p.is_file():
            return p
    raise LibvirtError(f"ISO não encontrada: {iso}")


def default_graphics_type() -> str:
    g = (os.environ.get("ZIONVM_GRAPHICS") or "vnc").strip().lower()
    return g if g in ("vnc", "spice") else "vnc"


def console_host() -> str:
    return (
        os.environ.get("ZIONVM_CONSOLE_HOST")
        or os.environ.get("ZIONVM_VNC_HOST")
        or "127.0.0.1"
    )


def graphics_port_for_vmid(vmid: int, graphics: str | None = None) -> int:
    kind = (graphics or default_graphics_type()).lower()
    base = 6900 if kind == "spice" else 5900
    return base + (int(vmid) % 400)


def build_domain_xml(
    *,
    name: str,
    memory_mb: int,
    cpu: int,
    disk_path: Path,
    iso_path: Path | None,
    bridge: str,
    vnc_port: int,
    vlan_tag: int | None = None,
    graphics_type: str | None = None,
    spice_port: int | None = None,
    cloud_init_iso: Path | None = None,
    firmware: str | None = None,
    machine: str | None = None,
    tpm: bool = False,
) -> str:
    iso_xml = ""
    if cloud_init_iso and cloud_init_iso.is_file():
        iso_xml += f"""
    <disk type='file' device='cdrom'>
      <driver name='qemu' type='raw'/>
      <source file='{cloud_init_iso}'/>
      <target dev='sdb' bus='sata'/>
      <readonly/>
    </disk>"""
    if iso_path and iso_path.is_file():
        iso_xml += f"""
    <disk type='file' device='cdrom'>
      <driver name='qemu' type='raw'/>
      <source file='{iso_path}'/>
      <target dev='sda' bus='sata'/>
      <readonly/>
    </disk>"""
    fw = (firmware or "bios").strip().lower()
    machine_type = machine or ("pc-q35-8.0" if fw == "uefi" else "pc")
    loader_xml = ""
    if fw == "uefi":
        loader_xml = """
    <loader readonly='yes' type='pflash'>/usr/share/OVMF/OVMF_CODE.fd</loader>
    <nvram>/var/lib/libvirt/qemu/nvram/{name}_VARS.fd</nvram>""".format(name=name)
    tpm_xml = ""
    if tpm:
        tpm_xml = """
    <tpm model='tpm-tis'>
      <backend type='emulator' version='2.0'/>
    </tpm>"""
    vlan_xml = ""
    if vlan_tag is not None and int(vlan_tag) > 0:
        vlan_xml = f"""
      <vlan>
        <tag id='{int(vlan_tag)}'/>
      </vlan>"""
    gtype = (graphics_type or default_graphics_type()).lower()
    if gtype == "spice":
        sport = int(spice_port if spice_port is not None else vnc_port)
        graphics_xml = f"""
    <graphics type='spice' port='{sport}' autoport='no' listen='0.0.0.0'/>
    <video>
      <model type='qxl' ram='65536' vram='65536' vgamem='16384' heads='1'/>
    </video>
    <channel type='spicevmc'>
      <target type='virtio' name='com.redhat.spice.0'/>
    </channel>
    <channel type='spiceport'>
      <source channel='org.spice-space.webdav.0'/>
      <target type='virtio' name='org.spice-space.webdav.0'/>
    </channel>"""
    else:
        graphics_xml = f"""
    <graphics type='vnc' port='{int(vnc_port)}' autoport='no' listen='0.0.0.0'/>"""
    return f"""<domain type='kvm'>
  <name>{name}</name>
  <memory unit='MiB'>{memory_mb}</memory>
  <vcpu>{cpu}</vcpu>
  <os>
    <type arch='x86_64' machine='{machine_type}'>hvm</type>{loader_xml}
    <boot dev='cdrom'/>
    <boot dev='hd'/>
  </os>{tpm_xml}
  <features>
    <acpi/>
  </features>
  <devices>
    <disk type='file' device='disk'>
      <driver name='qemu' type='qcow2'/>
      <source file='{disk_path}'/>
      <target dev='vda' bus='virtio'/>
    </disk>{iso_xml}
    <interface type='bridge'>
      <source bridge='{bridge}'/>{vlan_xml}
      <model type='virtio'/>
    </interface>{graphics_xml}
    <console type='pty'/>
    <channel type='unix'>
      <target type='virtio' name='org.qemu.guest_agent.0'/>
    </channel>
  </devices>
</domain>"""


def vnc_port_for_vmid(vmid: int) -> int:
    return graphics_port_for_vmid(vmid, "vnc")


def spice_port_for_vmid(vmid: int) -> int:
    return graphics_port_for_vmid(vmid, "spice")


def _console_payload(*, vnc_port: int | None, spice_port: int | None, graphics: str) -> dict:
    host = console_host()
    mode = "spice" if graphics == "spice" and spice_port else "vnc"
    if mode == "spice":
        return {
            "graphics": "spice",
            "console_mode": "spice",
            "spice_port": spice_port,
            "spice_host": host,
            "vnc_port": vnc_port,
            "vnc_host": host,
        }
    return {
        "graphics": "vnc",
        "console_mode": "vnc",
        "vnc_port": vnc_port,
        "vnc_host": host,
        "spice_port": spice_port,
        "spice_host": host if spice_port else None,
    }


def console_info_from_domain(dname: str) -> dict:
    try:
        xml = _run(["virsh", "dumpxml", dname])
    except LibvirtError:
        return _console_payload(vnc_port=5900, spice_port=None, graphics="vnc")
    vnc_m = re.search(r"<graphics type='vnc'[^>]*port='(\d+)'", xml)
    spice_m = re.search(r"<graphics type='spice'[^>]*port='(\d+)'", xml)
    vnc_port = int(vnc_m.group(1)) if vnc_m else None
    spice_port = int(spice_m.group(1)) if spice_m else None
    graphics = "spice" if spice_m and not vnc_m else "vnc"
    if spice_m and vnc_m:
        graphics = default_graphics_type()
    return _console_payload(vnc_port=vnc_port, spice_port=spice_port, graphics=graphics)


def map_domstate(raw: str) -> str:
    text = (raw or "").strip().lower()
    if "running" in text or "paused" in text:
        return "running"
    return "stopped"

target_metadata = Base.metadata


def run_migrations_offline() -> None:

    connectable = engine_from_config(

)

async def _column_exists(conn, table: str, column: str) -> bool:
    result = await conn.execute(
        text(

    )
    return result.scalar() is not None

router = APIRouter()


def _agent_package_dir() -> Path:
    """Resolve pasta do pacote lab (volume /agent, data/agent, ou repo)."""
    here = Path(__file__).resolve()
    candidates = [
        Path("/agent"),
        here.parents[2] / "data" / "agent",  # backend/app/data/agent
        here.parents[4] / "agent" if len(here.parents) > 4 else Path(),  # repo/agent
    ]
    for path in candidates:
        if path and (path / "sentinel_lab_agent.py").is_file():
            return path
    # fallback data even if empty (404 later)
    return here.parents[2] / "data" / "agent"


@router.get("/package/info")
async def agent_package_info(_: User = Depends(require_viewer)):
    root = _agent_package_dir()
    files = sorted(p.name for p in root.glob("*") if p.is_file()) if root.is_dir() else []
    return {
        "version": "0.2.0-lab",
        "package_dir": str(root),
        "files": files,
        "install_windows": {
            "download_ps1": "/api/agents/package/install-windows.ps1",
            "download_agent": "/api/agents/package/sentinel_lab_agent.py",
            "example": (
                'powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File install-windows.ps1 '
                '-Token "<token>" -Url "http://localhost:8800" -StartNow'
            ),
        },
        "docs": "docs/AGENT-LAB.md",
    }


@router.get("/package/{filename}")
async def download_agent_package_file(filename: str, _: User = Depends(require_viewer)):
    allowed = {
        "sentinel_lab_agent.py",
        "install-windows.ps1",
        "uninstall-windows.ps1",
    }
    if filename not in allowed:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Arquivo não disponível no pacote lab")
    path = _agent_package_dir() / filename
    if not path.is_file():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Pacote lab não encontrado no servidor")
    media = "text/plain; charset=utf-8" if filename.endswith((".py", ".ps1")) else "application/octet-stream"
    return FileResponse(path, media_type=media, filename=filename)


@router.get("/install.ps1", response_class=PlainTextResponse)
async def agent_install_ps1_shortcut(_: User = Depends(require_viewer)):
    """Atalho para baixar o installer Windows (mesmo conteúdo do pacote)."""
    path = _agent_package_dir() / "install-windows.ps1"
    if not path.is_file():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="install-windows.ps1 ausente")
    return PlainTextResponse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), media_type="text/plain; charset=utf-8")

import logging

)

    verify_totp,
)
from app.services.security_policy import password_change_required, validate_new_password

def _default_role() -> UserRole:
    mapping = {
        "admin": UserRole.ADMIN,
        "operator": UserRole.OPERATOR,
        "viewer": UserRole.VIEWER,
    }
    return mapping.get(settings.ldap_default_role.lower(), UserRole.VIEWER)


async def _authenticate_user(db: AsyncSession, username: str, password: str) -> User | None:
    result = await db.execute(select(User).where(User.username == username))
    user = result.scalar_one_or_none()

    if settings.ldap_enabled and authenticate_ldap(username, password):
        if user is None:
            user = User(
                username=username,
                hashed_password=get_password_hash(password),
                role=_default_role(),
                is_ldap=True,
                must_change_password=False,
                password_changed_at=datetime.now(UTC),
            )
            db.add(user)
            await db.commit()
            await db.refresh(user)
        return user

    if user and verify_password(password, user.hashed_password):
        return user
    return None


def _issue_access_token(user: User) -> str:
    return create_access_token(
        data={"sub": user.username, "role": user.role.value},
        expires_delta=timedelta(hours=24),
    )


def _issue_mfa_token(user: User) -> str:
    return create_access_token(
        data={"sub": user.username, "purpose": "mfa"},
        expires_delta=timedelta(minutes=5),
    )


def _audit(action: str, user: User) -> None:
    try:
        from app.db_sync import SyncSession
        from app.services.audit_service import log_audit

        with SyncSession() as session:
            log_audit(
                session,
                action=action,
                resource_type="user",
                resource_id=user.username,
                user_id=user.id,
                username=user.username,
                org_id=user.org_id,
            )
            session.commit()
    except Exception:
        logger.exception("Failed to write %s audit log", action)


def _user_response(user: User, *, must: bool | None = None) -> UserResponse:
    effective_must = (
        must
        if must is not None
        else password_change_required(user, max_age_days=settings.password_max_age_days)
    )
    return UserResponse(
        id=user.id,
        username=user.username,
        role=user.role,
        is_ldap=user.is_ldap,
        is_oidc=bool(getattr(user, "is_oidc", False)),
        is_active=user.is_active,
        must_change_password=effective_must,
        password_changed_at=user.password_changed_at,
        password_max_age_days=settings.password_max_age_days,
        mfa_enabled=bool(getattr(user, "mfa_enabled", False)),
        email=getattr(user, "email", None),
        org_id=user.org_id,
    )


@router.post("/login", response_model=Token)
async def login(
    request: Request,
    form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
):
    from app.services.rate_limit import limit_login

    limit_login(request)

    user = await _authenticate_user(db, form_data.username, form_data.password)
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Usuário ou senha inválidos")

    changed = False
    if not user.is_ldap and user.password_changed_at is None and not user.must_change_password:
        user.password_changed_at = datetime.now(UTC)
        changed = True

    must_change = password_change_required(user, max_age_days=settings.password_max_age_days)
    if must_change and not user.must_change_password and not user.is_ldap:
        user.must_change_password = True
        changed = True

    if changed:
        await db.commit()

    if bool(getattr(user, "mfa_enabled", False)) and getattr(user, "mfa_secret", None):
        return Token(
            access_token=None,
            token_type="mfa_required",
            must_change_password=must_change,
            mfa_required=True,
            mfa_token=_issue_mfa_token(user),
        )

    token = _issue_access_token(user)
    _audit("auth.login", user)
    return Token(access_token=token, must_change_password=must_change, mfa_required=False)


@router.post("/mfa/verify", response_model=Token)
async def verify_mfa(
    request: Request,
    body: MfaVerifyRequest,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
):
    from app.services.rate_limit import limit_auth_sensitive

    limit_auth_sensitive(request)

    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(body.mfa_token, settings.secret_key, algorithms=[ALGORITHM])
        if payload.get("purpose") != "mfa":
            raise JWTError("not mfa token")
        username = payload.get("sub")
        if not isinstance(username, str):
            raise JWTError("missing sub")
    except JWTError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Token MFA inválido ou expirado") from exc

    result = await db.execute(select(User).where(User.username == username))
    user = result.scalar_one_or_none()
    if not user or not user.is_active or not user.mfa_enabled:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="MFA não disponível para este usuário")

    secret = decrypt_mfa_secret(user.mfa_secret)
    if not secret or not verify_totp(secret, body.code):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Código MFA inválido")

    token = _issue_access_token(user)
    _audit("auth.mfa_verify", user)
    return Token(access_token=token, must_change_password=must_change, mfa_required=False)

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status

from app.dependencies import require_operator, require_viewer
from app.models import User

@router.get("/{device_id}/config", response_model=list[ConfigBackupResponse])
async def list_device_config_backups(device_id: int, _: User = Depends(require_viewer)):
    from app.db_sync import SyncSession
    from app.services.enterprise_service import list_config_backups

    with SyncSession() as session:
        backups = list_config_backups(session, device_id)
        rows = []
        for i, b in enumerate(backups):
            older = backups[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(backups) else None
            changed = bool(older and older.content_hash != b.content_hash)
            rows.append(
                ConfigBackupResponse(
                    id=b.id,
                    device_id=b.device_id,
                    content_hash=b.content_hash,
                    backup_type=b.backup_type,
                    created_at=b.created_at,
                    changed=changed,

            )
    return rows

@router.post("/{device_id}/config/{backup_id}/request-restore", status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
async def request_config_restore(
    device_id: int,
    backup_id: int,
    user: User = Depends(require_operator),
):
    from app.config import settings as cfg
    from app.db_sync import SyncSession
    from app.models import ConfigBackup
    from app.services.phase18_service import create_change_approval

    if not cfg.remediation_hitl_enabled:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, detail="HITL desabilitado")

    with SyncSession() as session:
        backup = session.get(ConfigBackup, backup_id)
        if not backup or backup.device_id != device_id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Backup não encontrado")
        approval = create_change_approval(
            session,
            kind="config_restore",
            playbook_slug=f"config_restore:{device_id}:{backup_id}",
            user=user,
            reason=f"Restaurar config backup #{backup_id} no device {device_id}",
            payload={"device_id": device_id, "backup_id": backup_id, "content_hash": backup.content_hash},
        )
        session.commit()
        return {
            "approval_id": approval.id,
            "status": approval.status,
            "kind": approval.kind,
            "message": (
                "Pedido de restore enviado para HITL (Platform → Autonomous). "
                "Após aprovar, o worker SSH aplica o running-config no device."
            ),
        }

import time

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.config import settings
from app.database import get_db
from app.dependencies import require_operator, require_viewer
from app.engines.discovery.dns_resolver import iter_host_addresses, validate_subnet
from app.models import DiscoveryJob, DiscoveryJobStatus, User
from app.engines.discovery.scan_options import list_scan_defaults, resolve_scan_options
from app.schemas.discovery import (
    DiscoveryJobCreate,
    DiscoveryJobResponse,
    ScanDefaultsResponse,
)
from app.services.discovery_service import (
    cycle_discovery_job_ids_if_needed,
    fail_stuck_pending_discovery_jobs,
    fail_orphaned_discovery_jobs,
    fail_stale_discovery_jobs,
    has_active_discovery_job,
    prune_discovery_jobs,
    reconcile_cancelled_discovery_jobs,
    stop_discovery_job,
)
from app.workers.discovery_tasks import run_discovery_job

router = APIRouter()

MAX_JOBS = settings.discovery_jobs_max_history
_RECONCILE_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 30.0
_last_reconcile_monotonic = 0.0


def _maybe_reconcile_discovery_jobs() -> None:
    """Reconcilia jobs órfãos/stale no máximo a cada 30s (evita esgotar pool no polling)."""
    global _last_reconcile_monotonic
    now = time.monotonic()
    if now - _last_reconcile_monotonic < _RECONCILE_INTERVAL_SECONDS:
        return
    _last_reconcile_monotonic = now

    from app.db_sync import SyncSession

    with SyncSession() as session:
        stale = fail_stale_discovery_jobs(session)
        stuck = fail_stuck_pending_discovery_jobs(session)
        orphaned = fail_orphaned_discovery_jobs(session)
        reconciled = reconcile_cancelled_discovery_jobs(session)
        if stale or stuck or orphaned or reconciled:
            session.commit()


@router.get("", response_model=list[DiscoveryJobResponse])
async def list_discovery_jobs(
    limit: int = MAX_JOBS,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: User = Depends(require_viewer),
):
    cap = min(max(limit, 1), MAX_JOBS)

    _maybe_reconcile_discovery_jobs()

    result = await db.execute(
        select(DiscoveryJob).order_by(DiscoveryJob.created_at.desc()).limit(cap)
    )
    return result.scalars().all()


@router.get("/scan-defaults", response_model=ScanDefaultsResponse)
async def get_scan_defaults(_: User = Depends(require_viewer)):
    return list_scan_defaults()


def _build_scan_options_payload(payload: DiscoveryJobCreate) -> dict:
    if payload.scan_options:
        opts = payload.scan_options.model_dump(exclude_none=True)
    else:
        opts = {"profile": "standard"}

    if payload.scan_options is None or payload.scan_options.use_snmp is None:
        opts["use_snmp"] = payload.use_snmp
    community = payload.snmp_community or opts.get("snmp_community")
    if community:
        opts["snmp_community"] = community
    communities = payload.snmp_communities or opts.get("snmp_communities")
    if communities:
        opts["snmp_communities"] = [str(item).strip() for item in communities if str(item).strip()]
    return opts


@router.post("", response_model=DiscoveryJobResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_202_ACCEPTED)
async def start_discovery(
    payload: DiscoveryJobCreate,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: User = Depends(require_operator),
):
    try:
        validate_subnet(payload.subnet)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail=str(exc)) from exc

    from app.db_sync import SyncSession

    with SyncSession() as session:
        if has_active_discovery_job(session):
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                detail="Já existe um scan em andamento. Cancele-o antes de iniciar outro.",
            )
        cycle_discovery_job_ids_if_needed(session)
        session.commit()

    scan_opts_dict = _build_scan_options_payload(payload)
    resolved = resolve_scan_options(
        scan_opts_dict,
        snmp_community_fallback=payload.snmp_community or settings.snmp_community,
    )

    job = DiscoveryJob(
        subnet=payload.subnet,
        use_snmp=resolved.use_snmp,
        snmp_community=resolved.snmp_community,
        snmp_communities=resolved.snmp_communities,
        scan_options=scan_opts_dict,
        status=DiscoveryJobStatus.PENDING,
        progress_percent=0,
        progress_label=f"Aguardando worker · perfil {resolved.label}",
        hosts_processed=0,
        devices_found=0,
        devices_inactive=0,
        total_hosts=len(iter_host_addresses(payload.subnet)),
    )
    db.add(job)
    await db.flush()

    async_result = run_discovery_job.apply_async(args=[job.id], queue="discovery", priority=9)
    job.celery_task_id = async_result.id
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(job)

    with SyncSession() as session:
        prune_discovery_jobs(session, keep=MAX_JOBS)
        session.commit()

    return job


@router.post("/{job_id}/stop", response_model=DiscoveryJobResponse)
async def stop_discovery(
    job_id: int,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: User = Depends(require_operator),
):
    job = await db.get(DiscoveryJob, job_id)
    if not job:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Job não encontrado")

    if job.status in (DiscoveryJobStatus.COMPLETED, DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED):
        return job

    from app.db_sync import SyncSession

    with SyncSession() as session:
        sync_job = session.get(DiscoveryJob, job_id)
        if not sync_job:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Job não encontrado")
        stop_discovery_job(session, sync_job)
        session.commit()
        session.refresh(sync_job)
        response = DiscoveryJobResponse.model_validate(sync_job)

    return response


@router.get("/{job_id}", response_model=DiscoveryJobResponse)
async def get_discovery_job(
    job_id: int,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: User = Depends(require_viewer),
):
    job = await db.get(DiscoveryJob, job_id)
    if not job:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Job não encontrado")
    return job

async def register_push_token(
    payload: PushTokenRegister,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    user: User = Depends(require_viewer),
):
    platform = (payload.platform or "expo").strip().lower() or "expo"
    existing = await db.execute(select(PushToken).where(PushToken.token == payload.token))
    row = existing.scalar_one_or_none()
    if row:
        row.user_id = user.id
        row.platform = platform
        row.updated_at = datetime.now(UTC)
    else:
        row = PushToken(user_id=user.id, token=payload.token, platform=platform)
        db.add(row)
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(row)
    return PushTokenResponse(id=row.id, platform=row.platform, created_at=row.created_at.isoformat())

from sqlalchemy import select

from app.database import get_db

async def list_monitors(
    device_id: int | None = None,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),

):
    query = select(Monitor).order_by(Monitor.id)

@router.post("", response_model=MonitorResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
async def create_monitor(
    payload: MonitorCreate,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: User = Depends(require_operator),
):
    device = await db.get(Device, payload.device_id)
    if not device:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Dispositivo não encontrado")
    monitor = Monitor(**payload.model_dump())
    db.add(monitor)
    await db.flush()
    await db.commit()

):

    await db.refresh(monitor)
    return monitor

):

    stripe_signature: str | None = Header(None, alias="Stripe-Signature"),
):
    from app.db_sync import SyncSession
    from app.services.audit_service import log_audit
    from app.services.phase17_service import handle_stripe_webhook

    body = await request.json()
    event_type = body.get("type", "simulated.checkout")

    return result

"""API Platform Backup — menu Backup (Fase 28)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.dependencies import require_admin, require_operator, require_viewer
from app.models import User
from app.services.rate_limit import limit_write

router = APIRouter()


class RunBackupRequest(BaseModel):
    mode: str = Field(default="full", pattern="^(full|incremental)$")
    repository_id: int | None = None


class ScheduleUpsert(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    mode: str = Field(default="full", pattern="^(full|incremental)$")
    interval_hours: int = Field(default=24, ge=1, le=168)
    repository_id: int
    enabled: bool = True
    retention_days: int = Field(default=30, ge=1, le=3650)


class ReplicateRequest(BaseModel):
    target_kind: str = Field(default="secondary", pattern="^(secondary|offsite)$")


@router.get("/overview")
async def backup_overview(_: User = Depends(require_viewer)):
    from app.db_sync import SyncSession
    from app.engines.backup.platform_backup import overview

    with SyncSession() as session:
        return overview(session)


@router.post("/jobs/run")
async def backup_jobs_run(
    payload: RunBackupRequest,
    request: Request,
    user: User = Depends(require_operator),
):
    limit_write(request)
    from app.db_sync import SyncSession
    from app.engines.backup.platform_backup import bootstrap_repositories, run_backup_job
    from app.services.audit_service import log_audit

    with SyncSession() as session:
        repos = bootstrap_repositories(session)
        repo_id = payload.repository_id or next(r.id for r in repos if r.kind == "primary")
        try:
            job = run_backup_job(
                session,
                repository_id=repo_id,
                mode=payload.mode,
                triggered_by=user.username,
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            session.rollback()
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc
        log_audit(
            session,
            action="backup.run",
            resource_type="backup_job",
            resource_id=str(job.id),
            user_id=user.id,
            username=user.username,
            org_id=user.org_id,
            details={"mode": payload.mode, "status": job.status},
        )
        session.commit()
        return {"job_id": job.id, "status": job.status, "mode": job.mode}


@router.post("/schedules")
async def create_schedule(
    payload: ScheduleUpsert,
    request: Request,
    user: User = Depends(require_admin),
):
    limit_write(request)
    from app.db_sync import SyncSession
    from app.models import BackupSchedule
    from app.services.audit_service import log_audit

    with SyncSession() as session:
        sched = BackupSchedule(
            name=payload.name,
            mode=payload.mode,
            interval_hours=payload.interval_hours,
            repository_id=payload.repository_id,
            enabled=payload.enabled,
            retention_days=payload.retention_days,
            next_run_at=datetime.now(UTC) + timedelta(hours=payload.interval_hours),
        )
        session.add(sched)
        session.flush()
        log_audit(
            session,
            action="backup.schedule_create",
            resource_type="backup_schedule",
            resource_id=str(sched.id),
            user_id=user.id,
            username=user.username,
            org_id=user.org_id,
            details=payload.model_dump(),
        )
        session.commit()
        return {"id": sched.id}

async def verify_artifact(artifact_id: int, _: User = Depends(require_viewer)):
    from app.db_sync import SyncSession

    from app.services.audit_service import log_audit

    with SyncSession() as session:
        try:
            result = replicate_artifact(session, artifact_id, payload.target_kind)
        except Exception as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc
        log_audit(
            session,
            action="backup.replicate",
            resource_type="backup_artifact",
            resource_id=str(artifact_id),
            user_id=user.id,
            username=user.username,
            org_id=user.org_id,
            details=result,
        )
        session.commit()
    return result


@router.delete("/artifacts/{artifact_id}")
async def delete_artifact_endpoint(
    artifact_id: int,
    request: Request,
    force: bool = False,
    user: User = Depends(require_admin),
):
    limit_write(request)
    from app.db_sync import SyncSession
    from app.engines.backup.platform_backup import delete_artifact
    from app.services.audit_service import log_audit

    with SyncSession() as session:
        try:
            result = delete_artifact(session, artifact_id, force=force, actor=user.username)
        except PermissionError as exc:

        except ValueError as exc:

        log_audit(
            session,
            action="backup.delete",
            resource_type="backup_artifact",
            resource_id=str(artifact_id),
            user_id=user.id,
            username=user.username,
            org_id=user.org_id,
            details=result,
        )
        session.commit()
    return result


@router.get("/artifacts/{artifact_id}/restore-preview")

    _: User = Depends(require_viewer),
):

    return result.scalars().all()


@router.post("/jobs", response_model=ReportJobResponse, status_code=202)
async def create_report_job(
    payload: ReportJobCreate,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: User = Depends(require_operator),
):
    if payload.report_type not in ("devices", "events", "summary", "sla"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="report_type inválido")
    if payload.format not in ("xlsx", "pdf"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="format inválido")
    if payload.report_type in ("summary", "sla") and payload.format != "pdf":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="summary/sla exigem format=pdf")
    if payload.report_type not in ("summary", "sla") and payload.format == "pdf":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="PDF disponível apenas para summary/sla")
    if payload.report_type == "sla" and not payload.site_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="site_id obrigatório para relatório SLA")

    params = {"site_id": payload.site_id} if payload.site_id else None
    job = ReportJob(report_type=payload.report_type, format=payload.format, params=params)
    db.add(job)
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(job)
    days = payload.days if payload.report_type != "sla" else (payload.days or 30)
    generate_report_task.delay(job.id, days)
    return job


@router.get("/jobs/{job_id}/download")
async def download_report(job_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_viewer)):
    job = await db.get(ReportJob, job_id)
    if not job or not job.file_path:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Relatório não disponível")
    import os
    if not os.path.isfile(job.file_path):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Arquivo não encontrado")
    media = "application/pdf" if job.format == "pdf" else "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet"
    filename = os.path.basename(job.file_path)
    return FileResponse(job.file_path, media_type=media, filename=filename)

SSE_TICKET_SECONDS = 60


def _username_from_sse_credential(token: str) -> str | None:
    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(token, settings.secret_key, algorithms=[ALGORITHM])
        purpose = payload.get("purpose")
        # Aceita ticket SSE (purpose=sse) ou JWT de sessão legado (sem purpose)
        if purpose is not None and purpose != "sse":
            return None
        sub = payload.get("sub")
        return sub if isinstance(sub, str) and sub else None
    except JWTError:
        return None


@router.post("/ticket")
async def create_sse_ticket(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)):
    """Ticket JWT curto para EventSource (evita access token longo na query string)."""
    from app.config import settings
    from app.services.security_policy import password_change_required

    if password_change_required(current_user, max_age_days=settings.password_max_age_days):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="É necessário alterar a senha antes de continuar")
    ticket = create_access_token(
        data={"sub": current_user.username, "purpose": "sse"},
        expires_delta=timedelta(seconds=SSE_TICKET_SECONDS),
    )
    return {"ticket": ticket, "expires_in": SSE_TICKET_SECONDS}


@router.get("/monitoring")
async def monitoring_stream(
    request: Request,
    ticket: str | None = Query(None),
    token: str | None = Query(None, deprecated=True),
):
    """SSE de eventos de monitoramento, discovery e status."""
    credential = ticket or token
    if not credential:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Ticket ou token obrigatório")
    if not _username_from_sse_credential(credential):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Credencial SSE inválida")

    async def generate():
        queue = await event_bus.subscribe()
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            for item in event_bus.recent(5):
                if await request.is_disconnected():
                    break
                yield f"data: {json.dumps(item)}\n\n"
            while True:
                if await request.is_disconnected():
                    break
                if time.monotonic() - started > SSE_MAX_SECONDS:
                    yield f"data: {json.dumps({'type': 'reconnect', 'payload': {}, 'created_at': ''})}\n\n"
                    break
                try:
                    event = await asyncio.wait_for(queue.get(), timeout=10.0)
                    yield f"data: {json.dumps(event.to_dict())}\n\n"
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    yield f"data: {json.dumps({'type': 'heartbeat', 'payload': {}, 'created_at': ''})}\n\n"
                    await asyncio.sleep(0)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            raise
        finally:
            event_bus.unsubscribe(queue)

    return StreamingResponse(
        generate(),
        media_type="text/event-stream",
        headers={
            "Cache-Control": "no-cache",
            "Connection": "keep-alive",
            "X-Accel-Buffering": "no",
        },
    )

async def _relay_display_tcp(websocket: WebSocket, host: str, port: int) -> None:
    """Relay binário WS ↔ TCP (VNC RFB ou SPICE)."""
    reader, writer = await asyncio.wait_for(
        asyncio.open_connection(host, port),
        timeout=float(settings.zionvm_vnc_connect_timeout_seconds),
    )

    async def ws_to_tcp() -> None:
        try:
            while True:
                msg = await websocket.receive()
                if msg["type"] == "websocket.disconnect":
                    break
                data = msg.get("bytes")
                if data:
                    writer.write(data)
                    await writer.drain()
        finally:
            writer.close()
            try:
                await writer.wait_closed()
            except Exception:
                pass

    async def tcp_to_ws() -> None:
        try:
            while True:
                chunk = await reader.read(65536)
                if not chunk:
                    break
                await websocket.send_bytes(chunk)
        except WebSocketDisconnect:
            pass

    await asyncio.gather(ws_to_tcp(), tcp_to_ws())

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Instala o SentinelAI Lab Agent no Windows (pacote lab — equivalente prático a MSI).

.DESCRIPTION
  Copia o agent para ProgramData, grava agent.json, opcionalmente instala psutil,
  e registra Tarefa Agendada "SentinelAI-LabAgent" (logon / a cada 1 min se cair).

.EXAMPLE
  .\install-windows.ps1 -Token "agt_xxx" -Url "http://localhost:8800"

.EXAMPLE
  # Baixar installer da API e instalar:
  irm http://localhost:8800/api/agents/install.ps1 | iex
  # (depois chame Install-SentinelLabAgent -Token ... se o script for função)
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
  [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
  [string]$Token,

  [string]$Url = "http://localhost:8800",

  [int]$Interval = 30,

  [string]$InstallDir = "$env:ProgramData\SentinelAI\Agent",

  [string]$TaskName = "SentinelAI-LabAgent",

  [switch]$SkipPsutil,

  [switch]$StartNow
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$Url = $Url.TrimEnd("/")

Write-Host "=== SentinelAI Lab Agent installer ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "URL: $Url"
Write-Host "InstallDir: $InstallDir"

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $InstallDir | Out-Null

$agentPy = Join-Path $InstallDir "sentinel_lab_agent.py"
$agentJson = Join-Path $InstallDir "agent.json"
$wrapper = Join-Path $InstallDir "run-agent.cmd"

Write-Host "Baixando agent da API..."
try {
  Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$Url/api/agents/package/sentinel_lab_agent.py" -OutFile $agentPy -UseBasicParsing
} catch {
  $local = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "sentinel_lab_agent.py"
  if (Test-Path $local) {
    Write-Host "API indisponível — usando cópia local: $local" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Copy-Item $local $agentPy -Force
  } else {
    throw "Não foi possível obter sentinel_lab_agent.py ($_)"
  }
}

@{
  url      = $Url
  token    = $Token
  interval = $Interval
} | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -Path $agentJson -Encoding UTF8

@"
@echo off
cd /d "$InstallDir"
where python >nul 2>&1
if errorlevel 1 (
  where py >nul 2>&1
  if errorlevel 1 (
    echo Python nao encontrado no PATH. Instale Python 3.11+ e reabra o terminal.
    exit /b 1
  )
  py -3 sentinel_lab_agent.py
  exit /b %ERRORLEVEL%
)
python sentinel_lab_agent.py
"@ | Set-Content -Path $wrapper -Encoding ASCII

if (-not $SkipPsutil) {
  Write-Host "Instalando psutil (métricas reais)..."
  try {
    & python -m pip install --quiet psutil 2>$null
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { & py -3 -m pip install --quiet psutil 2>$null }
  } catch {
    Write-Host "psutil opcional — agent usa fallback de lab sem ele." -ForegroundColor Yellow
  }
}

$pythonCmd = $null
if (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $pythonCmd = (Get-Command python).Source }
elseif (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $pythonCmd = "`"$((Get-Command py).Source)`" -3" }
else { throw "Python não encontrado no PATH." }

$action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute "cmd.exe" -Argument "/c `"$wrapper`""
$triggerLogon = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtLogOn
$settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -AllowStartIfOnBatteries -DontStopIfGoingOnBatteries -RestartCount 3 -RestartInterval (New-TimeSpan -Minutes 1) -ExecutionTimeLimit (New-TimeSpan -Days 3650)
$principal = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId $env:USERNAME -LogonType Interactive -RunLevel Limited

Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName -Action $action -Trigger $triggerLogon -Settings $settings -Principal $principal -Force | Out-Null

Write-Host "Tarefa agendada registrada: $TaskName" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "Config: $agentJson"

if ($StartNow) {
  Write-Host "Iniciando agent agora..."
  Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName
}

Write-Host @"

Pronto.
  - Pasta: $InstallDir
  - Task:  $TaskName
  - Ver status: Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName
  - Logs: rode manualmente: & '$wrapper'
  - Remover: .\uninstall-windows.ps1

"@ -ForegroundColor Cyan

After=network-online.target libvirtd.service
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=${DEST}
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 ${DEST}/zionvm_node_agent.py

RestartSec=10
Environment=ZIONVM_URL=${URL}
Environment=ZIONVM_AGENT_TOKEN=${TOKEN}
Environment=ZIONVM_INTERVAL=30
Environment=ZIONVM_LOCAL_ROOT=${LOCAL_ROOT}

[Install]

echo "zionvm-agent installed (VNC_HOST=${VNC_HOST}, LOCAL_ROOT=${LOCAL_ROOT})"
echo "Check: systemctl status zionvm-agent"
